description: Index of all benchmark result sets for the GPU-SSM mismatch study
hypothesis: GPUs don't convert SSM arithmetic savings into proportional speed/energy gains because they're physically built for dense matmul, not sequential recurrence

result_sets.key_findings: SSM 100-200x slower than attention, <0.2% bandwidth utilization
SSM gap widens on A100 — 1000-1500x slower, <0.1% bandwidth utilization

conclusion: The GPU-SSM mismatch hypothesis is strongly confirmed on both T4 and A100. The performance gap widens on higher-end hardware, indicating a fundamental architectural mismatch that justifies custom SSM accelerator design (Kalman project).
